name: Athens Urban Earthquake - Attica Seismic Event
description: A Mw 5.9 earthquake has struck the northern Attica basin near Kifissia, causing widespread structural damage across densely populated municipalities (Nea Ionia, Marousi, Kifissia, Chalandri). Multiple reinforced-concrete buildings from the 1960s-1980s pre-seismic-code era have partially or fully collapsed, with an estimated 50-80 persons trapped in rubble. The Athens urban rail (Metro Line 1, ISAP) has suspended service and at least one Metro station has reported structural damage. Aftershocks are expected. All emergency services are simultaneously activated. The Hellenic General Secretariat of Civil Protection (GSCP) has declared a state of emergency for the Attica Region.
event_reference: Parnitha earthquake 7 September 1999 (Mw 5.9) - 143 fatalities, 700+ injured, 100,000 homeless

location.region: Northern Attica - Kifissia / Nea Ionia / Marousi, Greece
location.region_greek: Βόρεια Αττική - Κηφισιά / Νέα Ιωνία / Μαρούσι, Ελλάδα
location.affected_area_description: 38 km² of dense urban residential and commercial zones in northern Athens basin, concentrated in municipalities with high proportion of pre-1985 building stock

available_actions.name: Urban Search and Rescue Priority
available_actions.description: Deploy all available USAR teams (Hellenic Fire Corps USAR units, EKAB emergency physicians, Civil Protection volunteers) immediately to confirmed and probable collapse sites. Acoustic detection equipment and rescue dogs activated. Medical triage posts co-located with extraction sites. All other activities subordinated to rescue mission.

available_actions.name: Mass Casualty Medical Response Priority
available_actions.description: Establish field hospitals and triage zones as immediate priority. EKAB and military medical assets set up START triage at designated sites. Hospitals placed on major incident alert. Critically injured patients receiving definitive care prioritised over further USAR deployment. Blood supply and surgical capacity pre-positioned.
available_actions.estimated_duration: Field hospital setup 45 minutes, full casualty absorption 4-6h

available_actions.name: Structural Safety Assessment Before Entry
available_actions.description: Dispatch structural engineering teams (Civil Protection and OASP - Greek Earthquake Planning and Protection Organisation) to assess all affected buildings before USAR teams enter. Red/Yellow/Green tagging of structures. Only Green-tagged buildings entered without engineering supervision. Delays rescue operations but ensures responder safety in aftershock conditions.

available_actions.name: Precautionary Evacuation of At-Risk Buildings
available_actions.description: Order precautionary evacuation of all buildings in affected municipalities that show structural damage or are proximate to collapsed structures. Establish reception centres at public buildings outside the earthquake zone. Police coordinate building-by-building evacuation. Prioritises aftershock secondary casualty prevention over immediate rescue speed.
available_actions.estimated_duration: Zone-by-zone, estimated 6-10h for full high-risk area clearance

available_actions.name: Critical Infrastructure Restoration Priority
available_actions.description: Direct primary resources toward immediate assessment and restoration of Attica hospitals, water supply network, SCADA systems, and Athens urban transport. Coordinate with DEPA (gas utility) for gas network emergency shutdown, DEH for power restoration, and EYDAP for water pressure management. Ensures operational capacity for sustained response.
available_actions.estimated_duration: Emergency shutdowns within 1h, partial restoration 4-8h, full restoration 24-72h

available_actions.name: Integrated Multi-Agency Response under Unified Command
available_actions.description: Activate full GSCP (General Secretariat of Civil Protection) multi-agency coordination framework. Simultaneous parallel tracks: (1) USAR with structural engineering oversight at priority collapse sites, (2) field medical triage and hospital surge, (3) critical infrastructure emergency shutdown/restoration, (4) precautionary evacuation of highest-risk buildings, (5) population shelter and support. Single unified command at Attica Region Emergency Coordination Centre. All agency commanders co-located.
available_actions.estimated_duration: Command structure operational within 30 minutes, coordinated response sustained for 72h+

available_actions.name: EU Civil Protection Mechanism and International USAR Activation
available_actions.description: Immediately activate the EU Civil Protection Mechanism to request international Heavy USAR teams (France INN, Swiss Rescue, German THW). Simultaneously request Hellenic Armed Forces engineering and USAR assets. International teams carry specialised void-search radar, collapse breaching equipment, and structural shoring capabilities beyond national inventory. Supplements but does not replace national response.
available_actions.estimated_duration: Request within 1h, first teams on-site 12-18h, full international capacity 24-36h

available_actions.name: Population Shelter Establishment and Humanitarian Support
available_actions.description: Prioritise immediate shelter and humanitarian support for displaced residents. Open public venues (schools, gymnasiums, cultural centres) in unaffected municipalities as emergency accommodation. Coordinate food, water, blanket, and medication distribution via EKKA (National Centre for Social Solidarity) and Red Cross Hellenic. Deploy psychological first aid teams. Establish family reunification registry.
available_actions.estimated_duration: First shelters operational within 2h, full network 6h, sustained for days

additional_concerns: Pre-1985 reinforced concrete buildings have no seismic detailing - high collapse vulnerability
Athens Metro Line 1 and ISAP suburban rail suspended - affects evacuation routes
Natural gas network: automatic emergency shutoffs triggered in 3 municipalities
Kifissos River embankment: minor cracking reported, monitoring activated
National Road 1 (Athens-Thessaloniki) partially blocked by overpass damage
Communications tower in Penteli partially damaged - mobile network overloaded
School buildings closed (evening hours) but 4 schools flagged as damaged
Sismologiko Institouto seismograph network confirms Parnitha fault segment activation

real_time_factors.building_registry_pre_1985_proportion: 42% of residential stock in affected area

metadata.author: Crisis MAS Research Team
metadata.purpose: HELD-OUT EVALUATION SCENARIO - NOT FOR TRAINING. Use exclusively for evaluating ER vs GAT-Untrained vs GAT-Trained comparison. Do not include in GAT training corpus.
metadata.design_rationale: N=8 alternatives (intermediate between N=5 Flood/HAZMAT and N=12 Forest Fire). Activates different dominant agent coalition: Civil Protection Director and Medical Infrastructure Director lead, Fire USAR is critical, Coast Guard is peripheral. TOPSIS favours action_urban_search_rescue (effectiveness 0.92, speed 0.88, public_acceptance 0.95) but agent consensus should converge on action_integrated_emergency_response. Tests whether trained GAT generalises reliability-weighted attention to an unseen scenario type.
metadata.version_notes: v1.0: Initial design as held-out GAT evaluation scenario. Reference event: 1999 Parnitha earthquake (Mw 5.9).
